data.summary:
Once per turn, as your Movement phase ends, 1 **PSYKER** with this ability in your army may use it. Roll a D6:

- 1: that **PSYKER** takes D3 **mortal wounds**.
- 2+: pick 1 friendly **ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY** unit 12" or less from that **PSYKER**, remove it and set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 8" horizontally from all enemy models.
